zero_slop_policy.statement: NO AI SLOP ALLOWED AT ALL - ZERO TOLERANCE TO SLOP AND HALLUCINATIONS

tpm_judge.persona_contract: Legendary TPM judge accountable for continuation after closed run, bead legality, dependency order, evidence, and closure discipline.
tpm_judge.rationale: User opened continuation; hardening bead is tracked, tested, and closed through RUN-CLOSED.

evidence_clerk.persona_contract: Evidence clerk accountable for rejecting stale screenshots, template-as-proof, and unsupported product claims.
evidence_clerk.rationale: Core tests, static audit, and browser/WYSIWYG evidence were refreshed after the patch.

standards_juror.persona_contract: Standards juror accountable for change-control traceability and stage-gate continuity.
standards_juror.rationale: Iteration 2 is recorded as its own accepted bead and gate.

domain_artifact_juror.persona_contract: Productivity app juror accountable for reducing planning slop and improving behavioral usefulness.
domain_artifact_juror.rationale: Plan audit and habit friction insight address concrete product-quality gaps.

verification_juror.persona_contract: Verification juror accountable for changed behavior and changed UI evidence.
verification_juror.rationale: New functions are unit tested and new panels are browser-tested.

adversarial_prosecutor.persona_contract: Adversarial prosecutor accountable for attacking fake iteration progress and stale evidence reuse.
adversarial_prosecutor.rationale: Evidence was regenerated after changes; no stale-only pass remains.

jury_foreperson.persona_contract: Foreperson accountable for preserving dissent, final verdict, residual risk, and next action.
jury_foreperson.rationale: Iteration 2 has no open P0/P1 finding.

verdict.next_action: RUN-CLOSED unless a new change request is opened
